meta.promptText: India mein oily skin ke liye 500 rupees ke andar konsa face wash kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Haan — **₹500 ke andar oily skin ke liye meri first choice Minimalist 2% Salicylic Acid + LHA Cleanser** hogi. Abhi iska 100 ml version roughly **₹250–₹300** ke aas-paas mil raha hai. Salicylic acid excess oil aur clogged pores ko target karta hai, isliye oily/acne-prone skin ke liye particularly useful hai.    Ye zyada gentle option hai; oil/dirt clean karta hai bina strong active ke. [www.ndtvshopping.com](https://www.ndtvshopping.com/beauty-and-grooming/best-face-washes-to-buy-for-indian-skin-oily-dry-dull-and-acne-10899929?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Mera verdict:** Agar tumhari skin **bahut oily hai aur pimples/blackheads bhi hote hain → Minimalist 2%**. Agar **sirf oily hai, acne nahi hai ya skin sensitive hai → Simple**.

Salicylic-acid face wash ko shuru mein **once daily** use karna better hai; agar dryness/irritation ho to frequency kam kar do.  

Agar tum bata do **tumhari age + pimples hain ya nahi + skin sensitive hai ya nahi**, main ₹500 ke andar **face wash + moisturizer + sunscreen ka complete combo** bhi suggest kar sakta hoon.
